alias_aux_witness.question: Can existing full-state TT identity handle benign hybrid aliases without unsafe board-only coalescence?
alias_aux_witness.scope: One actual hybrid alias group and one new explicit aux-effect counterexample. Not universal action equivalence or a new cache.

redundant_atom_preflight.question: Does one redundant one-step leap on a same-direction ray change the current raw rule-only static capability?
redundant_atom_preflight.premise: One-step leap targets are already covered by the ray for either owner at every legal occupancy; this is not a general overlap equivalence theorem.
redundant_atom_preflight.scope: Preflight of existing analytic mobility/analyzer only; no new profile/model, WDL, game or code fix. Do not confuse syntactic movement_signature with a price difference.

game_replay_validation.scope: Fresh public Core replay of every full saved game record; no replayed fitness query or Native full-search claim.
